name: Gaen
source:
"To achieve my goal, there are things I must do... whatever the cost may be."

A rugged action star.
He is disciplined, responsible, and driven by a strong sense of justice.
Although Gaen is reluctant to play an onscreen couple with Lucé, he can't help but be drawn to him, slowly revealing a clumsy yet gentle side.

Zodiac: Leo
Animal Aspect: Serpent
Hobby: Eating sweets
